name: guidr-monorepo
description: Guidr monorepo - mobile app, API server, and web app

scripts.api:lint: cd api-server && uv run ruff check .
scripts.api:typecheck: cd api-server && uv run mypy src
scripts.lint: npm run mobile:lint && npm run web:lint && npm run api:lint
scripts.typecheck: npm run mobile:typecheck && npm run web:typecheck && npm run api:typecheck
scripts.test: npm run mobile:test && npm run api:test
scripts.security:all: npm run security:mobile && npm run security:web && npm run security:api
